difficulty_reason: Prove 0 -> Pic(T) -> Pic(X_T) -> Picardfunctor_{X/S}(T) -> 0 is split exact with splitting sigma_T^* when f has a section and O_T = f_{T,*}O_{X_T}: K(T) = ker(sigma_T^*) gives Pic(X_T) = Pic(T) direct sum K(T), and lemma-flat-geometrically-connected-fibres puts K(T) inside Picardfunctor(T); Picardfunctor is the sheafification of K, so it remains to verify K is an fppf sheaf: given compatible local (L_i, alpha_i) with isomorphisms phi_ij, rescale each phi_ij by the unit u_ij so that the composite with sigma^* is the identity; the triple overlap self-map is multiplication by f_ijk with sigma^* f_ijk = 1, hence f_ijk = 1 by the pushforward assumption; the descent datum (fpqc descent) yields L with trivialization alpha recovering the local data.
